# Requirements Quality Checklist: Recitation Queue System

**Purpose**: Review F-003 requirements for completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage before task generation
**Created**: 2026-08-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by `/speckit.checklist`. It evaluates the quality of the written requirements and design contracts, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are round preparation, activation, reset, and finalization requirements defined for both scheduled and active F-005 session states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 B1 (FR-001 now defines automatic activation in round-number order: the first prepared round activates when the F-005 session goes live, each subsequent prepared round on previous-round finalization; no explicit activate-round action; FR-006 ties reset finalization to the same rule).
- [~] CHK002 Are eligibility requirements complete for explicitly pre-ordered students, currently present students, absent active students, late joiners, removed members, teachers, and supervisors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003] — DEFER→plan: eligibility is textual for pre-ordered/present/absent/late-joiner students and excluded teacher/supervisor roles (FR-002 "active student members", FR-003). Plan must state the mid-round membership-loss consequence explicitly: entry stays in place with no automatic transition; manager resolves via existing skip (FR-004); removed member loses queue visibility via the standard membership check (§Safety).
- [x] CHK003 Are the supported manager controls—reorder, move, advance, start, skip, complete, reset, correction, opt-out decision, and policy change—each assigned an unambiguous requirement outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007, §FR-012, §FR-013] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 I1/A2a/A2b (FR-004 now defines reorder, move, advance, start, and advance edge behavior).
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements present for grading-optional completion, including whether grade omission and later correction are allowed? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A2c (FR-007 updated: completion without grade allowed; later add/change only via FR-013).
- [~] CHK005 Are opt-out requirements complete for request creation, duplicate requests, decline, approval, automatic approval, a reciting requester, and manager-role loss while a request is pending? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — DEFER→plan: creation/duplicates (idempotent `OptOutRequest` entity), approval, auto-approve (FR-005), reciting requester (`waiting|reciting → opted_out`, FR-004), and role-loss-while-pending (any current teacher/supervisor may decide, §Safety operation-time checks) are covered. Plan must specify the decline path — request terminally closed and logged, entry remains `waiting` (the transition table permits no other outcome) — and that pending requests become non-actionable when the round finalizes.
- [x] CHK006 Are grade/note projection requirements defined for queue snapshots, realtime events, reconnect recovery, historical rounds, and every visibility policy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-009, §FR-012] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 I3/A2d (visibility timing + re-fetch defined in FR-012; historical-round projection explicitly deferred to F-007, no F-003 history surface).
- [~] CHK007 Are audit requirements complete for policy changes, opt-out requests/decisions, skips, resets, turn transitions, completion, and grade/note corrections, including which records must be durable? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-013] — DEFER→plan: policy changes (FR-012 audited), opt-out decisions (FR-005 durably logged), and corrections (FR-013 redacted audit event) are specified; skips/resets/transitions/completions are durably preserved as queue history (FR-006, QueueEntry durable turn timestamps/history). Plan must enumerate which action classes produce discrete audit records vs state history, with actor attribution on every manager mutation.
- [~] CHK008 Are requirements defined for prepared-order visibility and editing before entries are materialized under `present_at_activation`? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002] — DEFER→plan: pre-activation editing is defined (FR-002 pre-set + A2a full-list reorder before activation; editing implies manager visibility of the prepared order). Plan must state that no student-facing pre-activation projection is added to the current-queue surface in MVP — the prepared order is manager-surface only.
- [x] CHK009 Is “eligible student” defined using exact membership, role, presence, removal, and session-state criteria at both preparation and activation time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002] — PASS: FR-002 defines eligibility as "active student members" (membership + student role; teachers/supervisors excluded) with presence at activation per policy; FR-001 defines session states (preparation while scheduled, turn execution only in active live session); removed/non-members are excluded textually by "active student member". Mid-round removal consequence is tracked under CHK002 (DEFER).
- [x] CHK010 Is the deterministic fallback order clear when only some eligible students have a manager-defined pre-set position or multiple joins share a timestamp? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 B2 (FR-002 now defines placement under `present_at_activation`: pre-set students keep their relative order first, then present active student members without a pre-set position are appended in join order; concurrent-join timestamp tie-break remains deferred to plan).
- [x] CHK011 Is “move” distinguished clearly from complete-list reorder, including which entries may move while another entry is reciting or selected? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A2a (move = one waiting entry to arbitrary slot; full reorder only pre-activation; reciting entry immovable).
- [x] CHK012 Is the durable meaning of “advance selects” explicit, including selection replacement, no-waiting-entry behavior, and interaction with an existing reciter? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A2b (replace-selection, clean no-waiting-entry rejection, reject while reciting).
- [x] CHK013 Is “without penalty” defined as no grade, no progress/practice record, no negative status derivation, and retained neutral audit history? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-008] — PASS: FR-005 (no penalty, durably logged factual history), FR-007 (grade exists only in atomic completion), and FR-008 (no progress/practice record for opted-out) jointly define no-grade/no-record/no-penalizing-state; any downstream derivation is F-007 work (I3) and cannot penalize without newly approved behavior.
- [x] CHK014 Is the difference between prospective workflow-policy changes and immediately effective visibility projections explicitly stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A2d (FR-012 updated: workflow prospective, visibility immediate/prospective on new snapshots and events, history never rewritten).
- [~] CHK015 Is “durably logged” distinguished from structured operational audit logging so retention and queryability expectations are unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-013] — DEFER→plan: "durably logged"/"audited" mean PostgreSQL-persisted business facts (FR-005, FR-012, FR-013 redacted event), not ops logs. Plan must name the durable audit store (tables with actor/timestamp/redaction) and state that operational logs are non-authoritative; history is preserved per FR-006 (no MVP retention policy exists to contradict).
- [x] CHK016 Are timeout, retry, retry-exhaustion, and reconciliation timing requirements quantified for media control, outbox delivery, and ended-session cleanup? [Gap, Plan §Phase 1] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A1 (5 retries + exponential backoff + parked replay; 5s audio-control timeout non-blocking; 10s finalization convergence target; Architect may refine in plan).

## Requirement Consistency

- [~] CHK017 Are the five queue-entry states consistent across the specification, data model, REST schemas, WebSocket catalog, and architecture state machine, with round/request lifecycles clearly separate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-006] — DEFER→plan: spec-internal five states and transitions are consistent (FR-004, FR-006) and `OptOutRequest` plus round active/finalized lifecycles are separate (Key Entities). Plan must re-sync data-model.md, openapi.yaml, and ws_events.md state machines with the 2026-08-23 FR-004/FR-006 updates (FR-015 duty).
- [~] CHK018 Are the four round types, five grades, and five closed policy dimensions identical across product decisions, specification, data model, and canonical contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-007, §FR-012] — DEFER→plan: 4 round types (FR-001), 5 grades (FR-007; frozen Assumption), and 5 policy dimensions (FR-012) are internally consistent and match the frozen MVP register. Plan must verify the same enums across data-model.md and canonical contracts (FR-015 duty).
- [x] CHK019 Does the separate advance/start contract remain consistent with every journey and architecture flow, with no remaining implication that grading automatically advances or completes a turn? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Phase 0] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 I1 (US1 scenarios 3/4 rewritten: advance = selection, separate start grants audio; FR-004 aligned).
- [x] CHK020 Are `present_at_activation` and `all_active_students` requirements consistent between pre-set ordering, activation population, and late-join behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003] — PASS: FR-002 (both policies + pre-set order) and FR-003 (append-once under `present_at_activation`; retain-without-duplicate under `all_active_students`) cohere, including absent-but-active students under `all_active_students`; students without an existing position simply follow the textual rule of their session's policy (late-join append vs none).
- [x] CHK021 Is `preserve_last_state` consistent with terminal round finalization, no actionable reciter, and the rule that only entry states use the canonical five values? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006] — PASS: FR-006 retains unfinished entry states as immutable historical facts while the round is finalized and non-actionable with audio revoked under either policy (2026-08-23 unfinished-entry clarification); the five-value vocabulary applies to entries only and round active/finalized is a separate lifecycle.
- [x] CHK022 Is F-003’s at-least-once notification wording consistent with the plan’s decision that F-008—not F-003—owns Firebase device-token and FCM delivery infrastructure? [Conflict, Spec §Safety/Reliability, Plan §Phase 1 Mobile] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 I4 (Safety/Reliability and SC-008 corrected: F-003 delivers REST/WS/in-app only with stable event IDs; FCM is F-008's).
- [x] CHK023 Is the planned `memorization_progress` ownership consistent with F-007’s future schema/view ownership and the prohibition on F-003 dashboards or Quran-map derivation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Assumptions] — PASS: FR-008 + Assumptions keep F-003 at record production (test type retained, excluded from Quran-map derivation) with projections owned by F-007 (I3); ARCHITECTURE.md/ADR-019 reconciliation completed by the Architect; data-model.md regeneration against it is covered by the CHK017/CHK018 defers.
- [x] CHK024 Are current-role authorization requirements consistent across REST mutations, realtime projections, pending opt-out decisions, session creator attribution, and mid-session role changes? [Consistency, Spec §Safety/Reliability, §FR-012] — PASS: one rule everywhere — current membership + role verified at operation time (§Safety); creator is attribution-only (§Safety, FR-012); projections follow FR-007 visibility + SC-008 "authorized clients" + FR-009 authorized re-fetch. Operation-time checks make mid-session role loss uniformly effective, and any current teacher/supervisor may decide a pending opt-out.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [~] CHK025 Can every invariant in SC-001 and SC-002 be measured under duplicate, concurrent, stale-version, retry, restart, and reconnect scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002] — DEFER→plan: SC-001/SC-002 name acceptance, concurrency, duplicate/retry, and reconnect evidence. Plan must add stale-version and restart scenarios (version checks, outbox replay on restart) to the SC-001/SC-002 evidence matrix.
- [~] CHK026 Does SC-003 enumerate every server-validated input named by the requirements, including policy values, order membership/uniqueness, expected versions, and opt-out decisions? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003] — DEFER→plan: every named validation target already exists as a requirement (§Safety transitions + one-position invariant; FR-007 grades/notes; FR-012 closed policy sets). Plan/test matrix must extend SC-003's enumeration to policy values, order membership/uniqueness, opt-out decisions, and expected-version conflicts.
- [x] CHK027 Is the “exactly one” completed-turn record criterion measurable for initial completion and every allowed correction without conflating insert and update outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-013] — PASS: SC-004 (completed ⇒ exactly one; skipped/opted-out ⇒ none) plus FR-013 (correction updates the same single record atomically, never creates another) yield a count-based measurable invariant; SC-006 covers each correction-policy value. Insert-vs-update test separation is plan-level test design.
- [~] CHK028 Is SC-005 broad enough to cover media secrets and provider identifiers in outbox metadata, audit metadata, error details, metrics labels, notification data, and client diagnostics? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005] — DEFER→plan: §Safety already enumerates credential/endpoint/room-reference/provider-identifier/URL prohibitions beyond SC-005's list. Plan must extend the SC-005 test matrix to outbox/audit metadata, error details, metrics labels, notification payloads, and client diagnostics.
- [x] CHK029 Does SC-007 define an observable convergence deadline or retry-exhaustion outcome for ended-session queue cleanup? [Gap, Spec §SC-007] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A1 (10-second convergence deadline + parked-retry exhaustion as observable terminal outcome).
- [x] CHK030 Does SC-008 define measurement start/end points, sample size, network assumptions, and treatment of disconnected clients for the 500 ms objective? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A1 (start = PG commit, end = dispatch to connected authorized clients, p95 ≤ 500 ms, ≥100 actions/scenario, local-network env, disconnected excluded + FR-009 re-fetch).

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [~] CHK031 Are alternate flows documented for an empty eligible population, a prepared round whose candidates become ineligible, and a session ending before its prepared round activates? [Coverage, Gap] — DEFER→plan: consequences exist but must be written out — an empty eligible population activates an empty round (advance then rejects cleanly per FR-004/A2b); ineligible candidates simply reduce the activated set (population = present eligible ∩ policy); a never-activated prepared round becomes permanently inert at session end (FR-014; turn execution requires an active session), retained with no entries.
- [~] CHK032 Are conflict requirements defined for simultaneous advance/start, reset/complete, reorder/late-join, opt-out/skip, policy/action, and correction/reset operations? [Coverage, Spec §Safety/Reliability] — DEFER→plan: the §Safety conflict invariant governs (one durable outcome; no second entry/active round/reciter/record). Plan must specify conflict serialization (version checks / row locks / transaction isolation) for each racing pair: advance/start, reset/complete, reorder/late-join, opt-out/skip, policy-change/action, correction/reset.
- [~] CHK033 Are recovery requirements specified for database commit followed by event failure, reciter grant failure, reciter revoke failure, application restart, and missing/closed media room? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-009, §FR-014] — DEFER→plan: A1 covers commit-then-event-failure (5 retries + exponential backoff + parked replay) and grant/revoke failure (5s timeout, non-blocking, queue state authoritative, audio converges). Plan must specify application-restart recovery (replay pending + parked outbox entries, converge audio state) and the closed/missing-media-room path through the same ReciterAudioControl timeout semantics.
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements explicit for stale or out-of-order grade visibility events after a policy change, including whether clients must discard or re-fetch? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 A2d (clients re-fetch current queue state on policy-change events via FR-009 pattern; delivered history never rewritten).
- [~] CHK035 Are requirements defined for note clearing, grade replacement, repeated identical correction, and correction attempts after each correction-policy boundary? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013] — DEFER→plan: grade replacement and add/change-after-completion are textual (FR-007/A2c), and policy boundaries are enforced at correction time (FR-013, SC-006 covers each policy value). Plan must define correction upsert idempotency (repeated identical corrections converge to one record state without duplicates) and note-clearing semantics (optional note may be cleared).
- [~] CHK036 Are round-number allocation and reset requirements defined under retries and concurrent creators so numbering remains sequential without history reuse? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006] — DEFER→plan: sequential numbering without reuse is a storage concern under the no-second-active-round invariant (§Safety) and history preservation (FR-006). Plan must specify per-session round-number allocation (DB sequence / unique constraint) stable under retries and concurrent creation/reset.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [~] CHK037 Are authentication, authorization, validation, rate-limit, and audit requirements traceable to every mutating and read/projection surface rather than stated only globally? [Security, Spec §Safety/Reliability] — DEFER→plan: global requirements exist (§Safety authN/authZ/validation; FR-005/FR-012/FR-013 audit; FR-009/SC-008 authorized surfaces). Plan must map them per concrete endpoint/event surface and apply platform rate limits (Constitution invariant 8) to queue REST/WS surfaces.
- [~] CHK038 Are privacy requirements specified for student names, grades, notes, opt-out facts, and audit metadata in addition to the explicit media-secret prohibition? [Privacy, Gap] — DEFER→plan: grades/notes are policy-gated (FR-007) and audit events redacted (FR-013). Plan must confirm the privacy stance per data class: queue identity/state (including opted-out facts) visible to authorized session participants only (FR-009, SC-008); no PII in metrics/labels (extension of SC-005, ties to CHK040).
- [~] CHK039 Are Arabic-first, RTL, accessibility, loading, empty, offline/reconnecting, and recoverable/terminal error-state requirements complete for student and manager queue experiences? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016] — DEFER→plan: FR-016 covers Arabic-first/RTL, reconnecting/recovery states, and manager-control availability on failure. Plan/mobile design must enumerate loading, empty, and recoverable-vs-terminal error states plus accessibility requirements for student and manager queue screens (repo-wide Arabic-first/RTL convention applies).
- [~] CHK040 Are observability requirements measurable for mutation latency, conflict rate, outbox backlog, delivery lag, media convergence, cleanup backlog, and invariant violations without exposing sensitive labels? [Gap, Plan §Research 10] — DEFER→plan: SC-007/SC-008 make finalization convergence and delivery latency measurable. Plan must define the operational metrics set (outbox/parked backlog, delivery lag, audio-convergence lag, cleanup backlog, conflict/rejection counters, invariant-violation alerts) with label hygiene per SC-005.

## Dependencies and Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK041 Are the exact F-001, F-002, and F-005 interfaces/facts consumed by F-003 documented without assigning queue behavior back to those features? [Dependency, Spec §Scope, Assumptions] — PASS: Scope + Assumptions document the consumed facts (F-001 auth/current-device sessions, F-002 membership/roles, F-005 lifecycle/presence/transport/media boundary); FR-009 names the existing queue surface and FR-010 the ReciterAudioControl boundary; queue behavior stays assigned to F-003 (Scope/FR-011). Exact signatures are deliberately plan-phase work (FR-015).
- [~] CHK042 Is the transient handling of F-005’s private room reference through the existing `ReciterAudioControl` signature reconciled with the prohibition on room references in F-003 persistence, events, logs, caches, and URLs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §SC-005] — DEFER→plan: §Safety + FR-010 keep F-003 free of room references. Plan/contracts must show the ReciterAudioControl signature carries only neutral identifiers (session/round/entry/user refs per ADR-015) so room references never enter F-003 code, persistence, events, or logs.
- [x] CHK043 Are F-007 and F-008 handoff requirements explicit enough that later progress and FCM work can consume stable F-003 records/events without schema or contract reinterpretation? [Dependency, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Phase 1 Mobile] — resolved by Clarifications 2026-08-23 I3/I4 (F-007 owns historical projections from F-003's preserved server-side history; F-008 projects from F-003's stable, durable event IDs; no F-003 history surface or FCM work).
- [~] CHK044 Are all explicit exclusions—scheduling, chat, payments, recording, video, AI assessment, timers, dashboards, auth redesign, and session/media rebuilding—consistent across spec, plan, contracts, and architecture? [Scope, Spec §FR-011] — DEFER→plan: Scope and FR-011 exclusion lists match, including history UI→F-007 and FCM→F-008 after I3/I4. Plan must re-verify plan.md/contracts/ARCHITECTURE exclusion lists against the updated spec (FR-015 duty).
